Package com.csse3200.game.entities.factories

Class EnemyFactory

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.entities.factories.EnemyFactory
public final class EnemyFactory extends Object
Builds every enemy in the game. Each creator reads that enemy's settings from configs/NPCs.json and returns an entity that is ready to be positioned and spawned. Friendly NPCs are built by com.csse3200.game.entities.factories.NPCFactory; neither factory calls the other.

Every method is static and the class cannot be instantiated. The private helpers at the bottom hold the parts the ten creators share: argument checks, the three base bodies, loot, animation, attack components, AI tasks, size and collider.

    • createCyclops

      public static Entity createCyclops(Entity target)
      Creates a Cyclops: a mini boss with a stomp, a lobbed rock and an eye laser.

      Task priorities decide which attack runs, because the highest priority among the tasks whose range covers the target wins and the ranged task ignores cooldown: the stomp ( MELEE_TASK_PRIORITY) up close, the laser (LASER_TASK_PRIORITY) at middle range and the rock (RANGED_TASK_PRIORITY) only beyond the laser's range. So the rock is never thrown at close range and the laser is never fired at long range.

      Pays MINI_BOSS_GOLD and carries no weapon item: its attacks are natural weapons and never drop.

      Parameters:
      target - entity to chase and attack; must not be null
      Returns:
      the Cyclops, ready to be positioned and spawned
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if target is null

    • createMedusa

      public static Entity createMedusa(Entity target)
      Creates Medusa, a mini boss that paces on the spot, bites up close and petrifies the player with a ranged gaze. Pays MINI_BOSS_GOLD; her bite and gaze are natural weapons and never drop.

      PLACEHOLDER BUILD: she uses the Cyclops-style natural weapons and the gorgon atlas. A hit freezes the player through the existing "applySpeedEffect" event, the same one lightning uses.

      Parameters:
      target - entity to attack (the player); must not be null
      Returns:
      Medusa, ready to be positioned and spawned
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if target is null or a design rule is broken

      Creates Cerberus, a stationary mini boss that bites anything inside its reach, very often. Pays MINI_BOSS_GOLD; the bite is a natural weapon and never drops.

    • createZeus

      public static Entity createZeus(Entity target)
      Creates Zeus, the final boss. He fights with a natural sword up close and throws lightning from range, and moves and chases like the other platformer enemies.

      Drops FINAL_BOSS_GOLD gold (his tortoise drop is not wired in yet). He carries no weapon item: his sword and lightning are natural weapons and never drop.

      PLACEHOLDER BUILD: Cyclops atlas and animation controller. The lightning fires the existing LIGHTNING projectile.

      Parameters:
      target - entity to chase and attack; must not be null
      Returns:
      Zeus, ready to be positioned and spawned
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if target is null or a design rule is broken

    • registerEnemySpawns

      public static void registerEnemySpawns()
      Registers the shipped enemy spawn names with EntitySpawnRegistry. Safe to call repeatedly, and a name a team has registered for itself is left alone.
